title: Application to Temporary Residence Permit Process Steps for Estonia
notice: No Estonian Embassy in Bangladesh. Apply for Temporary Residence Permit online via PPA portal (eesti.ee), then submit biometrics at the Estonian Embassy in New Delhi — Indian Visa required first.

processSteps.label: University Application : via DreamApply or university portal
bullets: Main intake: September | Application window: October–March
Target universities: TalTech, University of Tartu, Tallinn University, Estonian Business School

processSteps.label: Admission Letter from University
bullets: Tuition: €1,660–€7,500/year depending on program and university
ASTRA scholarship or university merit grants may reduce fees

processSteps.label: Financial Proof : ~€564/month minimum
bullets: Bank statement showing at least €564/month (≈€6,768/year) in savings
Scholarship letter can substitute or supplement bank statement

processSteps.label: Apply for Temporary Residence Permit : PPA online portal
bullets: Submit application at eesti.ee — fee: €96 | Processing: 2–3 months
Upload admission letter, financial proof, health insurance, accommodation proof

processSteps.label: Biometrics at Estonian Embassy New Delhi
bullets: No Estonian Embassy in Bangladesh — obtain Indian Visa first to travel to Delhi
Submit fingerprints and photo at Estonian Embassy New Delhi

processSteps.label: Arrive Estonia — Register & Get ID Code
bullets: Register at local government office within 30 days — receive Estonian personal code
Collect physical residence card; valid for duration of studies

costSteps.label: Temporary Residence Permit Fee : €96 — paid online via PPA portal
Indian Visa : required to travel to New Delhi for biometrics submission
Financial Proof in Bank : ~€6,768/year (€564/month) — your own money, not a fee
Tuition Fee : €1,660–€7,500/year — varies by university and program
Health Insurance : ~€100–€300/year — required for permit application
University Application Fee : ~€0–€50 depending on university
Air Ticket to Estonia : varies by season and route

contacts.name: Estonian Embassy New Delhi
contacts.address: 4 Panchsheel Marg, Chanakyapuri, New Delhi 110021, India

contacts.name: PPA — Police and Border Guard Board
contacts.address: Online application at eesti.ee — no physical office in Bangladesh
